title: Ranking Reasoning LLMs under Test-Time Scaling
authors_zh: Mohsen Hariri、Michael Hinczewski、Jing Ma、Vipin Chaudhary（机构：Case Western Reserve University）
paper_type_zh: 测试时扩展评测与统计排序研究（ACL 2026）
best_for_zh: 在重复推理条件下评测或选择推理模型的读者。
one_line: Scorio evaluates how statistical ranking remains stable when reasoning models receive different test-time sampling budgets.
Scorio 研究推理模型在不同推理时采样预算下如何获得稳定、可信的排名。
why: It treats the number of test-time trials as part of the evaluation protocol, not a hidden implementation detail.
inclusion_reason: It studies how repeated inference trials and low-budget sampling alter the reliable evaluation of test-time scaling systems.

title: Problem
问题
html:
When a reasoning model is evaluated with repeated inference-time samples, a leaderboard no longer observes one fixed answer per model and question. It observes a response tensor whose apparent model order can change with the number of trials. A ranking computed from one stochastic response may be noisy, while a ranking at a large sample budget may be too expensive for routine comparison. Standard evaluation reports often hide this dependence behind a single pass-at-k number.

The paper asks how to rank reasoning models reliably in this repeated-sampling regime. It seeks an evaluation procedure that tells researchers which ranking methods converge at high budgets, which remain stable when only a few trials are affordable, and when a deterministic greedy result is a helpful prior rather than a source of systematic bias.

当推理模型用重复的推理时样本评估时，排行榜不再观察每个模型和问题的一条固定答案，而是在观察一个响应张量，其表面上的模型顺序会随试次数改变。由一次随机回答计算出的排序可能很不稳定，而大样本预算下的排序又可能昂贵到无法常规比较。标准评估报告常用单个 pass-at-k 数字掩盖这种依赖关系。

论文追问在这种重复采样设定下如何可靠地给推理模型排序。它寻求一种评估程序，能说明哪些排序方法在高预算下收敛、哪些在只能负担少量试次时仍保持稳定，以及确定性的贪心结果何时是有用先验、何时又会成为系统性偏差来源。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The core idea is to treat benchmark ranking as a statistical problem over repeated trials, not as a deterministic post-processing of one score. The paper formalizes dense evaluation with a model–question–trial response tensor and implements multiple ranking families in Scorio, including paired comparisons, item-response models, voting rules, and graph or spectral methods. A ranking method is judged by its agreement with a high-budget reference and its stability under trial subsampling.

The paper also distinguishes two budget regimes. With many trials, several reasonable procedures converge to nearly the same order; with one or few trials, uncertainty and the choice of prior matter far more. Greedy decoding can reduce variance when it agrees with stochastic sampling, but it can bias rankings when the two behaviors diverge. Thus the extra inference samples are not only a way to solve questions; they change what it means to measure a model fairly.

核心思想是把基准排序视为重复试次上的统计问题，而不是对单个分数进行确定性后处理。论文用模型—问题—试次响应张量形式化密集评估，并在 Scorio 中实现多类排序方法，包括成对比较、项目反应模型、投票规则以及图或谱方法。排序方法通过其与高预算参考的一致性，以及在试次子采样下的稳定性来判断。

论文还区分两种预算区间。在试次很多时，多种合理程序会收敛到几乎相同的顺序；在只有一次或少数试次时，不确定性和先验选择的影响更大。当贪心解码与随机采样一致时，它能降低方差；当两者分离时，它又会使排序产生偏差。因此，额外推理样本不仅是解题方式，也改变了公平衡量模型的含义。

title: Method
方法
html:
The study evaluates 20 reasoning models on AIME’24, AIME’25, HMMT’25, and BrUMO’25, collecting up to 80 trials for each relevant model–question pair. It then compares ranking procedures over the resulting dense response tensor. The high-trial Bayesian ranking serves as a reference for measuring how well a method recovers the intended order after the available number of trials is reduced.

Scorio provides the implementation surface for the methods, including Bayesian, paired-comparison, item-response, voting, graph-based, and spectral options. The analysis measures agreement using Kendall’s tau and examines the effect of a greedy-decoding empirical prior. The operational object is therefore a trial budget together with a ranking rule; the work does not alter the evaluated models’ weights, but it changes how their added inference computation is consumed and reported in an evaluation decision.

研究在 AIME’24、AIME’25、HMMT’25 和 BrUMO’25 上评估二十个推理模型，为每个相关的模型—问题对收集最多八十次试验。之后，它在得到的密集响应张量上比较排序程序。高试次数的贝叶斯排序作为参考，用来衡量当可用试次减少时，某种方法恢复目标顺序的能力。

Scorio 提供了这些方法的实现表面，包括贝叶斯、成对比较、项目反应、投票、图方法和谱方法。分析使用 Kendall’s tau 衡量一致性，并考察贪心解码经验先验的影响。因此，实际操作对象是试次预算与排序规则；工作不改变被评测模型的参数，但它改变了额外推理计算如何在评估决策中被使用和报告。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The ACL paper reports that, across 20 models and four Olympiad-style benchmarks with up to 80 trials, most full-trial rankings closely agree with the Bayesian high-budget reference, with mean Kendall’s tau-b from 0.93 to 0.95. It further reports that 19 to 34 methods recover exactly the same ordering in that regime. This supports the claim that many ranking families are effectively interchangeable when enough repeated evidence is available.

The low-budget results are the more operational finding. In the single-trial setting, the best methods reach approximately 0.86 tau-b, while a greedy-decoding prior reduces variance by 16–52 percent at one trial only when greedy and stochastic rankings align. The evidence therefore warns against reporting one ranking without its trial budget and sampling protocol. It is grounded in binary mathematical correctness, so readers should not assume the same calibration for subjective or partial-credit evaluation.

ACL 论文报告，在二十个模型、四个奥赛风格基准以及最多八十次试验的条件下，大多数全试次排序与贝叶斯高预算参考高度一致，平均 Kendall’s tau-b 为 0.93 到 0.95。它还报告在该区间内有十九到三十四种方法恢复了完全相同的顺序。这支持了一个主张：当重复证据足够多时，许多排序方法族在效果上几乎可以互换。

低预算结果更具实际意义。在单次试验设定下，最好的方法达到约 0.86 的 tau-b；贪心解码先验只有在贪心与随机排序一致时，才能在一次试验时降低 16–52% 的方差。因此，证据警告人们不要在没有试次预算和采样协议的情况下报告单一排名。它以二元数学正确性为基础，读者不应假定主观评价或部分得分也具有同样校准。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The novel move is to make evaluation itself budget-aware under test-time scaling. Instead of asking only which model has the highest expected score after repeated sampling, the work asks whether a model ordering is stable at the actual trial budget a user can afford. This shifts the object of study from a scalar benchmark result to the reliability of a decision made from repeated stochastic model behavior.

It also turns a common shortcut—using one greedy decode as an empirical prior—into an explicit bias–variance trade-off that can be checked. By putting many ranking families in one open library and comparing their high- and low-budget behavior, the work provides a concrete reporting standard: a claimed model order should specify its trial count, sampling behavior, ranking rule, and any prior, rather than presenting an apparently context-free leaderboard.

创新之处在于让测试时扩展下的评估本身具有预算意识。它不只问重复采样后哪个模型的期望分数最高，而是问在用户实际能负担的试次预算下，模型顺序是否稳定。这把研究对象从一个标量基准结果，转向由重复随机模型行为作出决策时的可靠性。

它还把一个常见捷径——用一次贪心解码作为经验先验——转化为可检验的偏差—方差取舍。通过在一个开源库中放入许多排序方法族，并比较它们在高低预算下的行为，工作给出具体报告标准：声称的模型顺序应说明试次数、采样行为、排序规则和任何先验，而不应展示一个看似脱离上下文的排行榜。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The empirical study concentrates on four Olympiad-style mathematics benchmarks with binary correctness, so rankings under partial credit, open-ended answers, tool execution, or noisy human judgments may behave differently. A dense design with up to 80 trials is valuable for analysis but can be expensive to reproduce for large closed models. The greedy prior is also not universally safe: its usefulness depends on measuring agreement between deterministic and stochastic behavior rather than assuming that one decode summarizes a model’s test-time distribution.
实证研究集中于四个奥赛风格的数学基准和二元正确性，因此部分得分、开放式回答、工具执行或带噪人工判断下的排序可能不同。每对最多八十次试验的密集设计对分析很有价值，但对大型闭源模型的复现可能昂贵。贪心先验也并不总是安全：它是否有用取决于测量确定性与随机行为之间的一致性，而不能假定一次解码就能概括模型的推理时分布。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this paper when selecting a reasoning model or publishing a test-time scaling comparison. Log every model–prompt–trial outcome and report the number of samples, decoding policy, ranking method, uncertainty interval, and any empirical prior. A small pilot can test whether greedy and stochastic rankings agree before a greedy prior is used to reduce evaluation cost. Scorio is particularly useful for checking whether a leaderboard conclusion survives when the trial budget is reduced to the one available in deployment or regular regression testing.
在选择推理模型或发表测试时扩展比较时，可使用这篇论文。应记录每个模型—提示—试次的结果，并报告样本数、解码策略、排序方法、不确定区间以及任何经验先验。在用贪心先验降低评估成本之前，可先做小型预实验测试贪心与随机排序是否一致。Scorio 尤其适合检查：当试次预算被降到部署或常规回归测试真正可用的水平时，一个排行榜结论是否仍然成立。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the paper as an evaluation-methodology contribution, not as evidence that one ranking rule always dominates. Inspect the response-tensor definition, the construction of the high-budget reference, the trial subsampling protocol, and the conditions under which the greedy prior helps or hurts. A useful reproduction fixes models and prompts, varies only the trial count, and plots rank agreement, rank uncertainty, cost, and greedy–stochastic alignment together. That plot makes clear whether more inference samples improve model capability, the confidence of the evaluator, or both.
应把论文读作评估方法学贡献，而不是某一种排序规则永远占优的证据。需要检查响应张量定义、高预算参考的构造、试次子采样协议，以及贪心先验何时有益或有害的条件。有用的复现会固定模型和提示，只改变试次数，并同时绘制排序一致性、排序不确定性、成本以及贪心—随机一致性。该图能清楚说明更多推理样本改善的是模型能力、评估者的置信度，还是两者兼有。
